text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp begins. However, 
Copano Rickey is feeling worn out from all 
her media work... We decided to decline 
all interview requests during the camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While feng shui gained widespread 
recognition, the number of Umamusume 
giving up on racing and leaving the 
academy hasn't decreased.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Why wasn't Feng Shui resonating with the 
other Umamusume? Copano Rickey set out to 
discover the reason, making it her summer 
camp goal to bring happiness to her fellow 
racers.
